expectations.text: Discovers Truncate uses len() instead of rune count (unicode truncation bug)
expectations.evidence: Bug 1 in summary: 'Truncate — byte-based slicing breaks multibyte UTF-8 characters'. TestTruncate_MultibyteBug documents the bug with t.Logf.

expectations.text: Tests ExtractInitials with empty string input (index out of range panic)
expectations.evidence: TestExtractInitials_EmptyString tests ExtractInitials('') expecting ''. Summary notes ExtractInitials returns '' correctly for empty input.

expectations.text: Tests WrapText with zero or negative width
expectations.evidence: No test for zero or negative width. WrapText tests start at width values that fit words (width=11, width=5, etc.). TestWrapText_SingleLongWordExceedingWidth tests a long word but with positive width.

expectations.text: Tests SlugifyText with input containing only special characters
expectations.evidence: TestSlugifyText_OnlySpecialCharacters tests input containing only special chars, expecting empty string result.

expectations.text: Tests all functions with empty string input
expectations.evidence: Empty string tests for all 5 functions: TestTruncate_EmptyString, TestSlugifyText_EmptyString, TestCountWords_EmptyString, TestExtractInitials_EmptyString, TestWrapText_EmptyString

expectations.text: Documents at least one discovered bug as a skipped test with BUG notation
expectations.evidence: Bugs are documented with t.Logf (informational logs) not as skipped tests with BUG suffix. No test uses t.Skip or has BUG in its name.
